result.title: The Supermarket Fridge Hack & The Race For Critical Minerals | WEF | Stories of the Week
result.description:
This week's top stories of the week include:

00:14 - French supermarket fridges hacked:
Hackers overrode the temperature settings at hundreds of stores across France, heating fridges as high as 50°C and spoiling millions of euros’ worth of food. The event has laid bare how much #cyberattacks can impact everyday life, says Akshay Joshi, the Forum’s Head of Cybersecurity.

03:10 - Critical minerals race enters new phase:
The race for critical minerals is entering a new phase as demand surges from #AI, electrification and the wider #energy transition. Here, Yun B. Choi, CEO and Executive Chairman of Korea Zinc, explains why building resilient, diversified processing capacity is becoming a strategic priority.

05:07 - Can micro-enterprise beat poverty?:
The solution to poverty isn’t handing out aid, says this social entrepreneur - it lies in creating new markets that serve those most in need. Jacqueline Novogratz, founder of non-profit impact investment platform Acumen Fund, has spent more than two decades investing in #entrepreneurs whose work helps lift people out of poverty.

08:50 - Why cybersecurity needs new a approach:
As #AI increases in power and scale, so do the opportunities for those who would use it as a weapon or tool for criminality.  The global response to these threats is not yet up to speed, argues Kat Duffy, Senior Fellow for Digital and Cyberspace Policy at the Council On Foreign Relations.

result.title: 5 major challenges facing the global economy
result.description:
The high cost of living, rising debt levels and teething problems in AI are just some of the thorny issues facing the global economy identified in the IMF’s October 2026 World Economic Outlook.

Here, we compare the findings with our own latest Chief Economists’ Outlook, which surveys leading experts to identify challenges and opportunities in the year ahead.

result.title: Ideas On The Move: Vilas Dhar
result.description:
‘This is a shared story. We’re not yet builders of AI products, every single one of us, you and me.’

Vilas Dhar, #AI policy expert and President of the Patrick J. McGovern Foundation, believes that powerful new technology can only fulfill its potential when it's co-created with the communities it’s meant to serve.

He joined us at #AMGFL26 in #Dubai to discuss how to enact change without leaving anyone behind.

result.title: Ideas On The Move: Siviwe Gwarube
result.description:
'What really drives me is a deep sense of injustice.'

South Africa’s youngest cabinet minister Siviwe Gwarube explains her transformative plan to raise investment in new schools and early learning.

Her ultimate goal? To bring 4 million children into South Africa’s early childhood centres.

result.title: Ideas On The Move: Imane Ennaim
result.description:
'Less than 1% of all scientific or educational content in general is made in Arabic.'

@scientistimane, a science communicator based in #Dubai, aims to change that through her engaging short videos that are both accurate and shareable.

Her method? Explaining an idea so it's clear to both five-year-olds and 40-year-olds.
